description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Subscription' class within the Opencart catalog module under the Account namespace. The class provides methods for managing customer subscriptions, including retrieving subscription details, histories, counts, and updating remaining periods.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class for managing customer subscription data including retrieval, updating remaining periods, and histories within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subscription record for the current customer by subscription ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionByOrderProductId
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription associated with a specific order ID and product ID for the current customer.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions for the current customer, with optional start and limit parameters for pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of active subscriptions for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionByShippingAddressId
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscriptions associated with a specific shipping address ID for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionByPaymentAddressId
methods.description: Returns the total number of subscriptions associated with a specific payment address ID for the current customer.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the history entries for a specific subscription, supporting pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Returns the total number of history records for a given subscription.

methods.name: editRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining period of a specific subscription.

methods.name: editTrialRemaining
methods.description: Updates the remaining trial period of a specific subscription.
